title: Dotted quarter and eighth
trains: A dotted quarter lasts a beat and a half; the eighth after it takes the last half beat, so the two fill two beats. Count "1 and 2 and": play on 1, hold through its "and" and beat 2, play the eighth on the "and" of 2.
